objective: Does relation-aware selection transfer to unscored phrasings on fresh real photos and preserve caption retrieval?
unit: scene-matched reciprocal original photo pair; both members retained together on the pre-score pixel audit
sampling: Historical UCM LoRA, native multi-round scene tool, eight stochastic draws and one greedy per image. Scene-only query primary, first archived caption secondary. Real val images reserved in full until training-set gate and checkpoint decision fixed.
selection: Within each image select maximal unweighted average of the midranks of A and B, average all tied choices. Historical reward = format + reciprocal proxy rank. Random = mean over the identical eight candidates.
primary: Average of C and D binary true-over-counterdescription margins under frozen downstream model, then average equally across images. Also report the two separately, reciprocal pair assignment and native all-caption RR.
training_gate: On train scene-only originals, A+B should exceed both random and historical reward on the primary mean; neither C nor D may lose to random, and original-caption gallery RR may lose at most 0.02 absolute vs random. If yes, run matched small policy updates and evaluate sealed fresh val. If no, release heldout performance, true-caption retrieval and geometric counterfactual as the planned diagnostics without updating the policy.
rotation: For each retained val hv or diag pair rotate each photo 90 degrees counterclockwise; for lr/tb/nose rotate 180 degrees. Opposite relation is then true. Non-axis-preserving contrasts grid/tilt excluded. Use the same per-candidate seeds, same scene cue and rerun entire tool loop and decoder from rotated pixels. Original photographs only for native-caption and native proxy-reward comparison, since proxy gallery indexes real original photos.
inference: Point estimates, percentile bootstrap by paired photos 20000 repetitions with seed 20261120. One UCM deployment. No formal test accesses.

short_training_if_promoted.order: random.Random(20261120).sample(sorted retained train image names,12); paired arms per-step same image and four per-image seeds
arms: mean midrank of two labeled relation margins A and B
short_training_if_promoted.optimizer: AdamW; group-normalized on-policy log likelihood; gradient norm clip 1.0
short_training_if_promoted.eval: fresh validation originals; neutral scene; each policy emits greedy and eight matched random draws without consulting relation labels for selection; compare C/D and native retrieval. End of step 12, no selection by validation.
